visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long dark hair, wearing a white t-shirt and grey flare jeans, is bending over a light grey sectional sofa, sorting through a pile of white and black laundry. A man in a black t-shirt and black joggers walks past her from left to right, looking intently at his smartphone. The setting is a brightly lit, modern living room with a textured white wall feature and a blue patterned rug. (2) The woman stands upright and begins shouting at the man, gesturing animatedly with her hands. The man turns toward her, drops his phone onto the sofa, and suddenly grabs her face with both hands, pulling her in for a firm kiss. (3) The woman points a finger at the man's face in an accusing manner. He smoothly blocks her arm, grabs her face again, and kisses her, causing her to stop talking. The scene cuts are rapid and synchronized with physical impacts. (4) The woman attempts a wide-arcing overhead swing with her right arm to hit the man. He fluidly ducks under her arm with a quick defensive posture and kisses her head while holding her cheek. (5) The woman tries to kick him with her right leg. The man catches her leg mid-air, lifts her entirely off the ground into a bridal-style carry, and kisses her deeply. Both characters are now smiling and laughing. (6) The woman faces the camera, smiling broadly and performing a playful victory dance with her arms. The man is seen in the background, now submissively picking up the laundry from the sofa and folding it.
